titleStmt.title: Musik til J.L. Heibergs romantiske komedie "Syvsoverdag"

work.title: Musik til J.L. Heibergs romantiske komedie "Syvsoverdag"
Music for J.L. Heiberg's Romantic Comedy "Seven Sleepers Day"

history.p: "Syvsoverdag" was performed for the first time at the gala performance celebrating the crowning of King Christian VIII and Queen Caroline Amalie at Frederiksborg Castle on 1 July 1840. After five performances that year it was taken off and not shown until September 1872. For these performances Hartmann revised his music and wrote six new pieces: No. 1 "Indledning" (instead of the overture); No. 3 Melodrama; No. 4 Prelude to Act Two ("Aften ved Ruinerne af Gurre Slot"); No. 5 Melodrama; No. 10 Melodrama and a new final chorus to a text by H.P. Holst written at the instigation of the actress Johanne Luise Heiberg.

titleStmt.title: Score, autograph, fair copy

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in library binding during the reign of King Christian X (1912-1947) with the original marbled paper cover and the new parts for the 1872 version: "Forspil til Syvsoverdag"", dated "13/8 72"; No. 3 "Melodram til 1ste Akts 16de Scene"; "No. 4 Indledning til 2den Akt. Aften ved Ruinerne"; "No. 5 Melodram / Efter anden Akts 1ste Scene (naar Balthasar har lagt sig under Busken)"; "No. 10 Melodrama" and "No. 17 Slutningssang" end-dated and signed: "31 Juli 1872. / I:P:E: Hartmann". The original score is written in black ink, the new parts in brown ink and pencil. Paper: 16 staves (original score). A vast number of emendations in pencil, ink, blue and red crayon. Numerous different paginations. At the bottom of each page paginated 1-217 in pencil at a much later date. The first page of the overture stamped: "DET KONGELIGE THEATERS EIENDOM". At the end of the original music signed and dated: "Finis. / I:P:E: Hartmann / Op 30. / d: 26/6 40." being four days before the first performance.

annot.p: This source is the original score used for the first performances in 1840. In 1872, however, Hartmann used the score for his revision of the music. Therefore it is a mixture of both versions. It was used as basis for the manuscript copy of the 1872 version.

annot.p: On the recto of the flyleaf: "Fru Johanne Louise Heiberg / tilegnet / af / Komponisten." On the verso: "'Syvsoverdag' opførtes første Gang paa det Kongelige Theater den 1ste Juli 1840 som Festforestilling i Anledning af Kong Christian den Ottendes og Dronning Caroline Amalies Kroning. Efterat være opført endnu nogle Gange i Løbet af samme Aar, henlagdes Stykket; først i September 1872 bragtes det atter paa Scenen. Ved denne Lejlighed er Musiken delvis bleven omarbejdet; nye ere Nr. 1 og Nr. 3, samt Slutningssangen, hvis Text er forfattet af H.P. Holst, der efter Fru Heibergs Anmodning har omformet Stykkets Slutning. Musiken til 'Syvsoverdag' fremtræder her for første Gang som Helhed; kun nogle enkelte Nummere deraf have været udgivne før. Nærværende Klaver-Udtog slutter sig væsentlig til den Form, hvori Stykket nu opføres."
